test_overview: Evaluated the admin auth/dashboard/CRUD test plan (58 pts). Steps 1-4 passed fully (admin auth flow with invalid-credential handling, dashboard sorting/pagination, search/filter, and creation propagating to visitor results with rating/Open/review-count). Step 5 FAILED FATALLY: after editing an establishment (name, status, rating) and clicking Save (button disabled showing 'Saving…'), the visitor-facing Cafes results — after explicit reload as the plan instructs — still displayed the OLD data (Test Cafe 123, Open, 4.2) instead of the edited values. The admin edits did not propagate to (and moreover did not appear persisted for) the visitor view. Per FAIL FAST rules the evaluation halted; Steps 6-8 (delete propagation, rating-hidden-when-empty, duplicate-name handling) were not executed and scored 0. Total: 32/58.

steps.description: test_admin_auth_and_dashboard_access: PASS. Unauthenticated /admin/dashboard redirected to /admin/login with Username/Password form. Invalid credentials (admin/wrongpass) showed 'Invalid credentials', cleared the password field, and remained on the login page. Valid login (admin/admin123) redirected to /admin/dashboard with a visible Logout button and a table containing Name, Category, Address, Status, Actions columns.

test_dashboard_sorting_and_pagination: PASS. With cleared search/filter, page 1 showed 20 establishment rows sorted alphabetically A-Z (verified by localeCompare sort). Pagination UI (prev/next + page numbers) present. Page 2 contained exactly 2 rows: 'The Commoner' and 'The Oaks Theater Cafe'.

test_dashboard_search_and_filter: PASS. Searching 'primanti' yielded exactly 1 row 'Primanti Bros. Strip District'. Case-insensitive match confirmed ('PRIMANTI' also matched). Category filter 'Playgrounds & Parks' displayed exactly 3 rows all in that category: Schenley Park Playground, Frick Park Blue Slide Playground, Point State Park. No other categories appeared.

test_create_establishment_appears_in_visitor_results: PASS. Created 'Test Cafe 123' (Cafes, Open, rating 4.2); redirected to /admin/establishments/23/edit with name exactly 'Test Cafe 123'. In visitor context_B, Home > Cafes listed the cafe with Open status and ⭐ 4.2 (0 reviews). Detail page /venue/23 confirmed rating 4.2, status Open, 0 reviews.

test_edit_establishment_updates_visitor_view: FAIL (FATAL -> evaluation halted). Edited establishment 23 setting Name='Test Cafe 123 (Edited)', Status='Closed', Rating='3.8' and clicked Save. The submit button became stuck disabled with 'Saving…'. Although the edit page reflected the new values in its heading/fields, reloading the visitor Cafes results (as the plan requires) still showed the OLD data 'Test Cafe 123', status Open, rating 4.2 — the edit did not propagate to the visitor-facing view. Required verifications (edited name present, edited status 'Closed' red, rating 3.8) all failed.
test_delete_establishment_removes_from_visitor_results: NOT EXECUTED (0 points). Evaluation stopped after the fatal Step 5 failure; delete-propagation behavior could not be assessed.
test_rating_hidden_when_empty: NOT EXECUTED (0 points). Evaluation stopped after the fatal Step 5 failure; the rating-hidden-for-empty-rating behavior could not be assessed.
